author: Pam Robinson
title: Firefighters to Compete in Rescue Challenge - NewsBreak
text:
By Pam Robinson ,
2 hours ago More than two dozen rescue teams from across the region will test their emergency response skills this weekend during the 19th annual Chuck Varese Vehicle Extrication Tournament in Northport.
The event, scheduled for Saturday at the Northport Fire Department Training Grounds at Steer’s Pit, will feature 27 teams representing 14 fire departments in a live-action rescue competition designed to simulate serious vehicle accidents.
Firefighters will race against the clock to safely remove mock victims from damaged vehicles, demonstrating the specialized techniques used in real-world crash rescues. Organizers say the event highlights the importance of hands-on training and coordination among emergency responders.
“This tournament showcases the dedication and professionalism of our firefighters while giving them valuable practical experience,” organizers said in announcing the event.
Gershow Recycling is supplying 30 vehicles for the competition, allowing teams to work through a variety of extrication scenarios similar to those encountered at crash scenes.
Representatives from the recycling company, including Huntington facility manager Richard D’Angelo and Vice President of Special Projects Steven Rossetti, are expected to attend.
Local elected officials are also expected at the event.
The competition begins at 9 a.m. Saturday at Steer’s Pit, located at the corner of Steers Avenue and Clipper Drive in Northport.
